maddeler.e:
يتبصبص (form IIq)
# يَتَبَصْبَصُ (yatabaṣbaṣu) /ja.ta.basˤ.ba.sˤu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَبَصْبَصَ (tabaṣbaṣa)
# يَتَبَصْبَصَ (yatabaṣbaṣa) /ja.ta.basˤ.ba.sˤa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَبَصْبَصَ (tabaṣbaṣa)
# يَتَبَصْبَصْ (yatabaṣbaṣ) /ja.ta.basˤ.basˤ/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَبَص
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
